fire: The toddler sat on the rug with both legs stretched out in front of her.
After the long hike my left leg ached for two whole days.
Stand tall, keep one leg slightly bent and relax your shoulders.

Our new leggings pair well with the long tunic for cooler days.
The horse lifted a front leg so the farrier could check the hoof.
She crossed her legs and leaned back in the old armchair.
Runners should stretch the back of each leg before a race.
